title: Staff of Accretion

sources.title: Accretion
markers: | description = The wearer gains {{Cond|Arcane Charge}} when they deal damage with close-quarter-range spells or close-quarter-range [[Cantrip|cantrips]].

summary: Unobtainable +1 staff grants Arcane Charge at close range.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, Versatile, 5 ft melee. 1d6 + 1 one-handed or 1d8 + 1 two-handed Bludgeoning plus Strength. +1 to attack rolls.
fields.Accretion: Damaging a creature with a close-range spell or cantrip grants Arcane Charge for 2 turns.
fields.Availability: Unobtainable. In unused Araj Oblodra stock.
fields.Base value: No nominal value is listed in the pinned item source.
fields.Topple: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. DEX save against weapon-action DC +2 or Prone for 1 turn. Prone breaks Concentration and expires at the start of the target’s turn. Topple skips main-hand weapon effects.
fields.Arcane Charge: Deal +2 spell damage against Threatened targets. The caster does not need to be Threatened. Separate damage instances, such as Magic Missile darts, can each receive the bonus.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
